name: Binary Search on Answer
cue: 'Minimum X such that feasible(X)', monotonic predicate
template:
lo, hi = low, high
while lo < hi:
    mid = (lo + hi) // 2
    if feasible(mid): hi = mid
    else: lo = mid + 1
